propositions: Continuous auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container during in-flight code reviews, causing interrupted reviews to cast fail-closed LLM-Review -1 votes that block automatic recovery
The shutdown drain timeout (45s) is much shorter than the review timeout (1200s), causing reviews to be cancelled mid-execution when a deploy occurs
Fail-closed -1 votes make changes invisible to the backfill reconciler, which only re-drives revisions with NO LLM-Review vote, preventing the designed recovery from executing
Retryable failures (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should defer voting and leave the change vote-less so the backfill reconciler can retry them
Terminal failures (indeterminate, finding) and successful reviews (PASS) should continue to cast definitive votes (-1 or +1)
After a bounded number of consecutive retryable failures on the same revision, escalate by casting the fail-closed -1 vote and emitting an alarm to surface the persistent error
